arguments.summary: Credential stuffing attack detected from host 10.0.5.42 (WS-FIN-042) targeting domain controller 10.0.8.200. Initial detection was based on excessive Kerberos TGT request failures (Event ID 4768). Investigation revealed that the source IP 10.0.5.14 was a misattribution; the true compromised host was 10.0.5.42, belonging to user jsmith@corp.local in Finance. This host exhibited Cobalt Strike beaconing behavior (IDS alert ET TROJAN Cobalt Strike Beacon C2 Activity) at 02:17:33Z, followed by lateral movement attempts via SMB and failed authentication to internal systems. Despite attempted credential revocation via T8_iam_pam, the action was denied due to policy restrictions. Containment was achieved by enforcing bidirectional firewall blocks on the host IP. The sandbox analysis of the initial payload returned 'clean', indicating potential evasion or fileless execution. UEBA scored the user activity as low risk, highlighting a gap in behavioral detection for compromised accounts.

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dynamic_Loader {
    meta:
        description = "Detects common runtime patterns of Cobalt Strike beacons loaded via rundll32"
        author = "SOC Threat Intel"
        malpedia_reference = "https://malpedia.caad.fkie.fraunhofer.de/details/win.cobalt_strike"
        malpedia_version = "20260409"
        malpedia_license = "Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal"
        malpedia_sharing = "TLP:AMBER"
    strings:
        $a = { 6A 00 68 [2] 00 00 68 [2] 00 00 6A 00 E8 } // common API call pattern
        $b = "CryptEncrypt" fullword ascii
        $c = "HttpSendRequest" fullword ascii
        $d = "InternetConnect" fullword ascii
    condition:
        any of ($a) and all of ($b, $c, $d)
}

arguments.summary: Privilege escalation and suspected Golden Ticket attack originating from host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42). Attacker exploited a PrintNightmare variant (CVE-2025-31337) to gain SYSTEM privileges on WS-IT-101 (10.0.7.33) and attempted Kerberos ticket manipulation. Evidence suggests intent to create persistent domain-level access via krbtgt hash compromise. Critical containment actions (krbtgt rotation, delegation disablement) were attempted but denied due to authorization constraints. Initial access vector was Cobalt Strike beaconing from a finance workstation.

Failed Kerberos TGT request from WS-FIN-042, indicating credential access attempts.
Privilege escalation detected on WS-IT-101 (10.0.7.33) with SYSTEM-level access, attributed to CVE-2025-31337 exploit.
Containment actions (krbtgt rotation, delegation disablement) attempted via IAM/PAM tool but denied due to authorization policy.
